wiki_remote.assessment: Public main repository has Wiki enabled; Wiki Git reads return Repository not found and web URL redirects to main repository. No accessible Wiki history/content; do not infer a remote commit or initialize/overwrite remotely.

anchor_policy: Explicit named qNNN anchor; GitHub GFM sanitization prefixes user-content-. Links use independently observed prefixed fragments; live Wiki behavior remains a post-publication check.

publication.qualification: Publication-ready local source; inspect/reconcile any remote Wiki history and verify live routing only after separate authorization.
